newsitem.title: JAPAN: Catalina coupons to target top ten Japan retailers.
newsitem.headline: Catalina coupons to target top ten Japan retailers.

text.p: U.S. Catalina Marketing Corp said on Thursday it aims to win contracts from Japan's top ten retailers for its RegiMarketing in-store electronic product coupon system.
Catalina will also aim to sell the system to some regional chainstore operators, David Van Buskirk, president of Catalina's unit Catalina Marketing International, told Reuters.
Catalina is the first provider of such a system in Japan and does not have any immediate competition.
"The Japanese retailers are far ahead than other markets in technological advances, like their electronic marketing capabilities," Van Buskirk said.
The RegiMarketing program consists of four promotion systems -- the RegiCoupon, the RegiSample, the RegiGame and the RegiMessage -- which issue a variety of coupons to the shopper.

Earlier on Thursday, leading supermarket operators Jusco Co Ltd and Seiyu Ltd said they decided to use the RegiCoupon, an electronic coupon operation system, on a trial basis in 10 of their outlets until December.
Japan's second largest retailer, Ito-Yokado Co Ltd, said it was still considering whether to apply the RegiMarketing program to its outlets.
"We still don't know how coupon marketing would fare in Japan. We would like to first see how the system works in other retailers," an Ito-Yokado spokesman said.
